title.hr: Iznimke od politike: prihvaćeni rizik s rokom isteka
title.en: Exceptions to policy: an accepted risk with an end date

concept.hr: Iznimka treba vlasnika, kontrolu i rok, inače iznimke postanu stvarna politika
concept.en: An exception needs an owner, a control and an end date, or it becomes the policy

summary.hr: Odobri dvije godine iznimki bez roka, s rokom ili s pregledom o isteku i gledaj koliko sustava stvarno zadovoljava standard i koliko je stara najstarija.
summary.en: Grant two years of exceptions with no end date, an unchecked date or a review at expiry; watch how much of the estate meets the standard and the oldest one.
